blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Criminal charges have been filed by the police against Thomas Markle Sr., the 82-year-old estranged father of Meghan Markle, who is married to Britain’s Prince Harry, over alleged possession and distribution of child sexual abuse materials. The PNP’s Women and Children Protection Center-Visayas Field Unit filed the case on Monday before the prosecutor’s office, PNP spokesperson Brig. Gen. Allen Rae Co told reporters on Wednesday. Regional prosecutor Graeme Elmido told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) that Markle was charged with two counts of distributing child sexual abuse materials and one count of possessing such materials under Philippine law.
